text: Two things from task 034's second test (run multiscale/20261122-1, collection collect-4; meta_agent/failures.jsonl test-034-2, hub-8, hub-9). (1) For docs/ideas/20261122.md, the person's words in this seat's conversation, each the option they chose: asked whether the MD agent's hand-over (relaxation_time 1.0147743482349956 s, polymer_viscosity 0.06687634087181032 Pa.s, E4) may cross to the CFD agent, '넘겨줘' (hand it over); asked what they give the CFD agent's eight run settings, '지난번 값 그대로' (the same as last time: solvent_viscosity 0.1 Pa.s, half_width 1 m, density 1 kg/m^3, driving 3 Pa/m, cells_across 41, dt 0.001 s, end_time 6 s, probe_every 50); asked what they give the six rows template v37 added (position, times, terms; courant_limit, cell_size, velocity), '모두 보류' (hold them all); asked to start the Colima profile rheotool, '켰음' (started) and, when it still showed Stopped, '켜는거 코드 적어줘' (write me the command to start it), after which they ran colima start -p rheotool and docker context use colima-rheotool themselves. (2) hub-8: src/hub.py status takes an item as answered only by a result whose state is answered, so the MD agent's partly_held result, which quoted both values and held 'the solvent viscosity' (the CFD agent's input), answers neither of its items and the question cannot be solved. One way is that a result's held entry names the items of its assignment it holds, so that an item is answered by a result that holds nothing for it; that changes result.schema.json's held items, so it is yours to say whether, and in what shape. The other way (status reading values per item) needs no card change but cannot tell which values answer which item. The template side, and hub-9 (src/hub.py open lets dontAsk through), wait for your answer and land in a later hub template.
